campaign.candidate_selection_status: This follow-on dataset was selected from public metadata after the GSE202150 outcome was known. It is not an independent replication of the candidate-selection process.
campaign.error_control_scope: The 0.0125 allocation governs this single frozen GSE185381 follow-on endpoint. No error-rate claim is made for the broader historical search across datasets.
campaign.later_rescue: A miss, refusal, interruption, or exception closes this branch. The allocated alpha cannot be reassigned to a replacement dataset.

cell_and_feature_contract.adt_axis_validity: A donor-marker ADT axis must contain at least two distinct processed ADT values, and its largest equal-value fraction must be at most 0.90.
cell_and_feature_contract.adt_state: For a valid donor-marker ADT axis, the 192 highest processed ADT values among the 384 frozen cells are high; salted SHA-256 and cell identifier break ties.
cell_and_feature_contract.marker_resolution: Each RNA and ADT processed matrix must resolve every frozen marker exactly once after exact alphanumeric canonicalization; otherwise the stage refuses.
cell_and_feature_contract.ordered_pair_validity: An ordered pair is valid exactly when its RNA row and ADT column are both valid. Every source and held donor must retain at least 9 valid RNA axes, 9 valid ADT axes, and 128 of 256 valid ordered pairs before prediction or scoring; otherwise the stage terminates without attrition or rescue.
cell_and_feature_contract.rna_axis_validity: Within-donor detection prevalence must lie in the closed interval [0.05, 0.95].
cell_and_feature_contract.rna_state: raw processed SoupX count greater than zero
cell_and_feature_contract.selected_pool_rule: Use only the donor's single frozen largest publisher-filtered CITE-seq pool. Never aggregate across pools.
cell_and_feature_contract.support_estimand: The donor-supported RNA-by-ADT submap; loss is averaged over each donor's informative ordered pairs without donor attrition.

claim_scope: Composition-inclusive transfer of RNA-ADT coupling from ten healthy bone-marrow control donors to 39 AML bone-marrow donors on one frozen 16-cognate panel. This is a post-GSE202150 follow-on held-donor study, not a clean independent candidate-selection replication or a cell-type-conditional causal claim.

mandatory_classical_families: untuned row-plus-column Poisson-independence signed-root-deviance residual at transport multiplier one
comparators.lock_rule: Before held access, select the estimable classical method with minimum component-equal source-validation deviance; retain the stated order for exact ties. The untuned residual is always reported even when another method locks.
comparators.unestimable_method: report a deterministic method-specific numerical or support refusal code; never silently drop it from the method inventory

held_inference.acquisition_cluster_definition: run-date prefix of the selected pool; GSM lanes from one run date are one cluster
held_inference.comparison: paired donor loss for the primary estimator minus the prospectively locked strongest classical comparator
pass_requirements: mean primary loss is at least 5% lower
the 98.75th percentile of the acquisition-cluster-stratified paired donor bootstrap is below zero
at least 32 of 39 donors favor the primary
the one-sided exact donor sign-test p-value is at most 0.0125
the one-sided exact acquisition-cluster sign-flip p-value is at most 0.0125
every leave-one-acquisition-cluster-out mean paired difference is negative
held_inference.primary_endpoint: donor-equal mean multinomial deviance per cell over the donor's informative ordered RNA-by-ADT pairs
held_inference.raw_residual_head_to_head: The same donor losses, paired differences, uncertainty interval, sign tests, and acquisition-cluster sensitivities are reported against the untuned Poisson residual whether or not it is the locked comparator.
serial_confirmatory_order: primary estimator versus the source-locked strongest classical comparator
primary estimator versus the graph-zero ablation, evaluated only after the primary gate passes
primary estimator versus the destroyed-link control, evaluated only after the graph-structure gate passes
held_inference.descriptive_contrasts: Untuned Poisson, target-margin independence, and nonlocked classical contrasts are reported outside the serial confirmatory chain.

held_separation.assay_hash_timing: Source-selected RNA and ADT files are hashed after the public source-stage claim. Files required only by held-selected pools are first downloaded and hashed in the held RNA or ADT stage. For the three source/held-overlap pools, the physical files are downloaded and hashed in source, but only frozen source columns are converted; held columns are first converted in their held modality stage.
held_separation.cohosted_source_rule: These source-stage CSV files physically contain unselected held-donor columns. The source stage may convert and use only frozen source-column indices; co-resident held values are not selected, serialized, fitted, or scored.
held_separation.prediction: Held RNA states and fixed 192/192 ADT margins create public same-margin predictions before held ADT states may be opened together with RNA states.
held_separation.private_artifacts: cell identifiers and binary states remain outside the repository; public records contain hashes, byte counts, margins, and predictions only
held_separation.assay_access_journal: Each assay stage opens an append-only public journal before access. The attempt tag binds its empty header, every downloaded assay file is recorded immediately with observed bytes and SHA-256, and the completion tag binds the full journal even after a terminal refusal.
held_separation.score: The score stage is the first stage allowed to join held RNA and ADT states or form held joint tables.

primary_estimator.graph: separate two-nearest-neighbor marker graphs are derived from calibration RNA and ADT profiles; their product incidence regularizes ordered coupling fields
primary_estimator.selection: Fit on the five frozen calibration donors and minimize component-equal deviance across the three pool-disjoint validation components, with lexicographic tie breaking. The primary grid contains only positive graph penalties.
primary_estimator.graph_zero_ablation: Select heterogeneity, ridge, and transport on the same source split with graph penalty fixed to zero; this ablation is not eligible to become the primary estimator.
primary_estimator.refit: Refit the selected configuration on all ten source donors before any held assay access.

terminal_rules.pre_score_support_or_numerical_failure: publish a terminal refusal without inventing a score
terminal_rules.stage_interruption_or_unexpected_excepti: consume and publish the stage attempt; do not rerun
